title: When frequency domain classification is superior to spatial
abstract: arXiv:2611.00073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern image classification models largely rely on local characteristics and feature extraction for their predictions. This focused approach works well in the spatial domain, but reportedly falls short in the frequency domain, even though both representations contain the same information. This study demonstrates that the significant reduction in accuracy in the frequency domain stems from the lack of local features. Locally swapping data in the frequency domain significantly decreases its inverse spatial domain accuracy, even below that of the frequency domain; however, the frequency domain accuracy remains relatively constant. Moreover, the use of datasets containing global features in the spatial domain yields higher accuracy in the frequency domain. translated_title: 当频域分类优于空间域时
translated_abstract: 现代图像分类模型在很大程度上依赖局部特征和特征提取来进行预测。这种聚焦的方法在空间域中效果良好，但据报道在频域中表现不佳，尽管两种表示包含着相同的信息。本研究证明，频域中准确率的显著下降源于局部特征的缺失。在频域中局部交换数据会显著降低其逆变换后空间域的准确率，甚至低于频域本身的准确率；然而，频域的准确率却保持相对稳定。此外，使用在空间域中包含全局特征的数据集会在频域中获得更高的准确率。基于这些结果，研究构建了一个混合模型，将仅在频域训练的模型和仅在空间域训练的模型相结合，以实现更高的分类准确率。
tldr: 研究揭示了频域分类准确率下降的根源在于局部特征的缺失，并据此构建了结合频域与空间域训练的混合模型以获得更高的分类性能。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that the reduced accuracy of frequency-domain classification stems from the lack of local features, and constructs a hybrid model combining frequency-domain and spatial-domain trained models to achieve higher classification performance.
